title: Chick Webb in 1931 and starting to compose
summary: Carter went with Chick Webb in 1931; his first published song was "Blues in My Heart".

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Right. Well, then it was in there that you became associated with -- you went to Chick Webb's around the early 30's, I think.

Right. Now you had already had a band for a short time. When did you -- I think ... now let's go to composing. And let's try to remember where we are; we are somewhere around 1931 where you -- after this experience with a few bands, you are now with Chick Webb, again, for a short time. With composing, when did you begin to compose? Do you remember?
Well, the first song I wrote was a song ... well, I wrote a number of songs in the early days, but the first one that was published was "Blues in My Heart" and that was in 1931.
